description: This file defines a PHP class 'Cheque' within the Opencart". It extends a system engine model and provides methods related to getting available payment methods for checks within the Opencart e-commerce platform. The class includes a method 'getMethods' that determines if the cheque payment option should be available based on various configuration and geographical zone conditions, and returns the configuration for the cheque payment method if applicable.
